name: Jest of the Forgotten Archive
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes additional damage equal to half the damage dealt (rounded down) from all sources until the beginning of your next turn. This additional damage is considered phrenic damage. If you have at least 1 rank in the Knowledge (history) skill, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your next attack roll.
